Here’s a concise summary of the **body-mind-on** project from the codebase:

---

## 1. Main pages (routes) and purpose

| Route | Purpose |
|-------|--------|
| **`/`** (`index.js`) | Marketing homepage: hero, “Jak to funguje”, CTA to START/Club/VIP. |
| **`/start`** | 7‑day free START signup: multi-step form (name, email, body metrics, goals, habits) → calls `assistant-intake` API, creates user, generates plan, sends email. |
| **`/on-club`** | ON Club signup flow (program: ON_CLUB), same pattern as START with habit selection. |
| **`/chci-vip`** | VIP signup flow (program: VIP), same pattern. |
| **`/club`** | Redirects to `/on-club`. |
| **`/vip`** | Redirects to `/chci-vip`. |
| **`/onboarding`** | Redirects to `/start` (optionally with `?plan=...`). |
| **`/register`** | Redirects to `/start` (optionally with `?plan=...`). |
| **`/login`** | Email + password login via Supabase Auth; on success → `/profil`. |
| **`/signup`** | Simple Supabase `signUp` (email + password), no plan generation. |
| **`/dashboard`** | Redirects to `/profil`. |
| **`/profil`** | Main app: profile, plan viewer, body metrics, workouts list, habit tracker, membership, “quick weight”, send plan again. |
| **`/training`** | 1:1 training booking: duration (30/60/90 min), submits to `/api/sessions`. |
| **`/pricing`** | Pricing page with links to START, on-club, chci-vip. |
| **`/admin`** | Admin only (`?key=ADMIN_TOKEN`): list of `body_metrics` rows, CSV export. |

---

## 2. Key API routes and what they do

| API route | Methods | Purpose |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| **`/api/assistant-intake`** | POST | Onboarding: validate input, store in `registrations`, create/update auth user, generate plan via `generatePlanForEmail`, send plan email. Rate limited by IP. |
| **`/api/generate-plan`** | POST | Generates personalized plan (HTML + metrics) from body/goals; used by plan generation flow (e.g. from `lib/generatePlan`). |
| **`/api/profile`** | GET | Returns full profile: `body_metrics`, `ai_generated_plans`, `workouts`, `user_habits`, `memberships`, `habit_logs` (current week). Auth: Bearer. |
| **`/api/profile-settings`** | (implied) | Profile/settings updates (referenced in codebase). |
| **`/api/body-metrics`** | POST | Create/update body metrics, optional plan generation, create auth user, set `user_habits`. Rate limited. |
| **`/api/my-metrics`** | GET | Fetches current user’s `body_metrics`. |
| **`/api/quick-weight`** | POST | Quick weight entry → insert into `body_metrics`. |
| **`/api/workouts`** | GET, POST, DELETE | CRUD workouts for user; filters `from`/`to`/`limit`. Auth: Bearer. |
| **`/api/habits`** | GET, POST, DELETE | CRUD habit logs (`habit_logs`); filter by date range and `habit_ids`. Auth: Bearer. |
| **`/api/user-habits`** | GET, POST | Get/update user’s selected habits (`user_habits`). Auth: Bearer. |
| **`/api/sessions`** | POST | Create 1:1 training session (duration, price) in `sessions` table. Auth: Bearer. |
| **`/api/send-plan-again`** | POST | Resend latest `ai_generated_plans` plan HTML to logged-in user’s email. |
| **`/api/send-shopping-list`** | (present) | Shopping list sending (details in `pages/api/send-shopping-list.js`). |
| **`/api/recipe`** | GET | Generate recipe for a dish name via OpenAI (e.g. when plan lacks detail). |
| **`/api/delete-account`** | POST | Delete user data (iterates over known tables). |
| **`/api/cron/daily-digest`** | GET/POST | Cron endpoint: list users, for each build digest (plan, today’s workouts, habits, recommendation) and send daily email. Protected by `CRON_SECRET`. |

---

## 3. Where user data (workouts, habits, plans) is stored and used

- **Storage:** Supabase (PostgreSQL). Tables used in code:
  - **`workouts`** – `user_id`, `workout_date`, `workout_type`, `duration_min`, `notes`, `perceived_difficulty` (migration `20260220_workouts_perceived_difficulty.sql`).
  - **`habit_logs`** – daily habit completion: `user_id`, `log_date`, `habit_id`, `completed`, `notes`.
  - **`user_habits`** – which habits the user tracks: `user_id`, `habit_id`, `is_positive`, `sort_order`.
  - **`ai_generated_plans`** – generated plans: `user_id`, `plan_html`, `plan_type`, `daily_calories`, `macros`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, etc.; written by `lib/generatePlan.js` and body-metrics/assistant-intake flows.
  - **`body_metrics`** – user metrics (weight, height, goals, program, etc.); used for profile and plan generation.
  - **`memberships`** – tier (START / ON_CLUB / VIP), status, `started_at`.
  - **`registrations`** – intake data from assistant-intake (e.g. name, email, body data before account creation).
  - **`sessions`** – 1:1 training sessions (duration, price, status).

- **Used in:**
  - **`/profil`** – Loads via `/api/profile` (workouts, plans, user_habits, habit_logs, body_metrics, membership); displays plan, workout list, habit tracker; can call `/api/workouts`, `/api/habits`, `/api/user-habits`, `/api/quick-weight`, `/api/send-plan-again`.
  - **`lib/dailyDigest.js`** – Builds daily email from `ai_generated_plans`, `workouts`, `body_metrics`, `habit_logs` (today).
  - **`lib/generatePlan.js`** – Reads `body_metrics`, writes `ai_generated_plans`, triggers plan email.

---

## 4. OAuth and external service integrations

- **Auth:** Supabase Auth only. Login is **email + password** (`signInWithPassword` in `login.js`). No Google/GitHub OAuth found in the codebase.
- **Email:** **Nodemailer** (SMTP) in `lib/mail.js` and `lib/dailyDigest.js` for plan emails and daily digest. **Resend** is in `package.json` but not used in code.
- **OpenAI:** Used for plan generation (e.g. assistant flow) and for **`/api/recipe`** (GPT‑4o‑mini for recipe text). Config/docs in `docs/OPENAI_ASSISTANT_INSTRUKCE.md`.

---

## 5. Where calendar/scheduling logic could fit

- **Daily digest:** Scheduling is **external**. The app only exposes the handler:
  - **`/api/cron/daily-digest`** – expects to be called by an external cron (e.g. Vercel Cron or other) at the desired time; it iterates users and sends one email per user using **`lib/dailyDigest.js`** (today’s meals from plan HTML, today’s workouts, habit logs, recommendation). No in-app cron or calendar.
- **Workouts:** Stored by **date** (`workout_date`); no recurring “schedule” or calendar UI—just list and filters (e.g. in `profil` and API `from`/`to`). Calendar/scheduling could be added by:
  - New API or page that reads/writes `workouts` (and optionally new “planned workouts” or recurring templates) and a calendar UI.
- **Habits:** Logged per **day** (`log_date`). No time-of-day or recurrence in schema; habits are “did I do this today?”. Scheduling could add:
  - Reminders (external cron + email/push) or a calendar view of `habit_logs` and `user_habits`.
- **Plans:** `ai_generated_plans` has `valid_from` / `valid_until` (e.g. 7 days). Daily digest already picks “today” from plan HTML by Czech day name. A calendar could show plan validity and which day’s meals/training are shown.

So: **calendar/scheduling** would mean new UI and possibly new tables or fields, with cron remaining external; the existing pieces (workouts by date, habits by day, digest by day, plan validity range) are the natural hooks for that logic.
